title: 林顼
text:
金融学博士研究生 · 厦门大学经济学院金融系
我是厦门大学经济学院金融系博士研究生，研究兴趣包括公司金融、绿色治理、创新、地缘政治与商业信用。
研究主要使用中国企业层面数据和因果推断方法，考察政策冲击如何影响企业的融资、供应链关系与投资决策。

title: Xu Lin
text:
Ph.D. Student in Finance · Department of Finance, School of Economics, Xiamen University
I am a Ph.D. student in Finance at the School of Economics, Xiamen University. My research interests include corporate finance, green governance, innovation, geopolitics, and trade credit.
My work uses Chinese firm-level data and causal inference methods to study how policy shocks shape firms’ financing, supply-chain relationships, and investment decisions.
